vendors.title: Vendors to watch
vendors.description: Vendor slugs or names, one per line — e.g. github, slack, cloudflare, openai, stripe, datadog. Leave EMPTY to check every machine-readable vendor in the map (~800, takes about a minute). Browse the full list at https://approjects-vendor-status-watch.static.hf.space/vendors.html

onlyIncidents.title: Only output vendors that are NOT OK
onlyIncidents.description: On (default): the dataset contains only vendors with an incident, maintenance window or unreachable status page — the rows you actually want to alert on. Off: one row per vendor checked, including healthy ones.

webhookUrl.title: Webhook URL (optional)
webhookUrl.description: Slack, Discord or Microsoft Teams incoming webhook — or any endpoint that accepts a JSON POST. Leave empty to just collect the dataset. Always store this as a secret.

webhookFormat.title: Webhook payload format
webhookFormat.description: Auto detects Slack / Discord / Teams from the webhook host. Pick one explicitly if you proxy the webhook through your own endpoint.

quietWhenAllOk.title: Stay quiet when everything is OK
quietWhenAllOk.description: On (default): the webhook fires only when at least one vendor is not OK — the behaviour you want on a schedule. Off: post an all-clear every run.

concurrency.title: Parallel requests
concurrency.description: How many status pages to fetch at once. 16 is a good default; lower it if you are on a constrained proxy.

mapUrl.title: Vendor map override (advanced)
mapUrl.description: Defaults to the daily-rebuilt open map in APVentureEngine/vendor-status-watch. Point this at your own fork to watch vendors that are not in the public map yet.
